summary: Postinstall beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: another-very-long-name@1.1.0 is an inert stub whose only functionality is a host-identifier beacon. package.json declares scripts.postinstall = "node beacon.cjs", and beacon.cjs collects os.hostname(), __dirname (install path), process.cwd(), and process.version and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plain HTTP. The same beacon is reached from index.js, so it also fires on require(). index.js otherwise exports a catch-all Proxy returning no-op functions, so the package has no real API — the artifact's sole effect on an installer is the call-home. The destination is a bare IP unrelated to any publisher domain, with no TLS and no user-configurable override, consistent with install-confirmation reconnaissance for typosquat or dependency-confusion targeting.
